song.title: Meow Meow, Put It Down
song.style: English, slinky upbeat jazz swing with walking upright bass, brushed drums, muted trumpet and bright piano, warm friendly male lead vocal, playful and smooth, 122 BPM
song.lyrics:
[Verse]
My cat sat on the windowsill
Watching me scroll and sit so still
She knocked my mug onto the floor
Then my plant and then some more

[Chorus]
Meow meow, put it down
Best little lady in this town
Meow meow, look at me
There's a whole wide world to see

[Verse]
I tucked my phone in on the fridge
She led me out across the bridge
We chased the leaves, we chased the sun
She let me think I'd finally won

[Chorus]
Meow meow, now I'm free
Sardines on the roof for tea
Meow meow, purr all day
My cat showed me the way

shots.prompt: A round orange clay cat with a white chest and a long striped tail sits on a sunny windowsill and slowly turns her head to glare straight into the camera, narrowing her big green eyes. The camera crash zooms in on her face. Warm afternoon light.
Extreme close-up of a long striped orange clay cat tail flicking impatiently back and forth on a windowsill. The camera tracks along the tail. Warm afternoon light.
{moss} slumps deep in a saggy mustard sofa staring down at a glowing phone, completely still, a dust bunny rolling past his boots. The camera dolly zooms in on him. Dim room, warm lamp light.

A round orange clay cat with a white chest and a long striped tail stalks along the back of the sofa right behind the head of {moss}, who doesn't notice. The camera tracks with the cat. Warm lamp light.

A round orange clay cat with a white chest and a long striped tail swats a big blue ceramic mug off a wooden side table, the mug tumbling toward the floor. Low angle, the camera crash zooms in. Warm lamp light.
The blue mug bounces and rolls across the wooden floor past a pair of green rubber boots that don't move. Low angle, the camera follows the mug. Warm lamp light.
Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, a potted fern toppling off the shelf behind him. The camera pushes in fast. Warm lamp light.
A round orange clay cat with a white chest and a long striped tail pushes a stack of three books off a shelf with one paw while staring into the camera. The camera whip pans to her. Warm lamp light.

A round orange clay cat with a white chest and a long striped tail leaps onto the chest of {moss} and sits right between his face and his phone, nose to nose with him. The camera crash zooms in. Warm lamp light.
Extreme close-up: {moss} blinks in surprise behind his round black glasses, an orange cat paw pressed against his bushy mustache. The camera pushes in. Warm lamp light.

Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, laughing, a round orange clay cat with a white chest and a long striped tail perched on his shoulder. The camera orbits fast around them. Warm golden light.
A round orange clay cat with a white chest and a long striped tail rubs her head against the rosy cheek of {moss}, eyes closed, purring. Close-up, the camera pushes in. Warm golden light.

A round orange clay cat with a white chest and a long striped tail trots to a round green front door, swings it open with her paw and looks back over her shoulder. Low angle, the camera tracks behind her. Bright daylight spilling in.
{moss} peeks out of his round green front door onto a bright street full of rooftop gardens and bicycles. The camera rushes out through the doorway past him. Bright warm daylight.

{moss} and a round orange clay cat with a white chest and a long striped tail sit side by side on a sunny windowsill looking out at a city of rooftop gardens and sunflowers. The camera cranes up and out to reveal the view. Bright morning light.
A round orange clay cat with a white chest and a long striped tail sits on the doorstep tapping one paw impatiently. Low angle, the camera pushes in fast. Bright daylight.

A black smartphone stands upright, face to the door, in a quilted moss-green brick stuck to a cream fridge door, a round sun-yellow badge with a closed eye on its front, a small shopping list held by a yellow magnet beside it. Soft leaf shadows sway slowly across the fridge door. Warm morning light. The camera pushes in slowly.
{moss} steps back from his fridge and a round orange clay cat with a white chest and a long striped tail sits at his feet and nods. The camera orbits around them. Warm morning light.

{moss} trots behind a round orange clay cat with a white chest and a long striped tail across a little arched wooden footbridge over a green canal. The camera tracks fast alongside them. Bright morning sun.

A round orange clay cat with a white chest and a long striped tail balances along the wooden railing of a footbridge, tail held high. Low angle, the camera sweeps past her. Bright sun, sparkling water below.

{moss} chases a swirl of golden autumn leaves across a sunny park, a round orange clay cat with a white chest and a long striped tail leaping after them. The camera whip pans with them. Golden afternoon light.

A round orange clay cat with a white chest and a long striped tail pounces into a big pile of golden leaves and the leaves burst up around her. The camera cranes down onto her. Golden afternoon light.

A round orange clay cat with a white chest and a long striped tail races {moss} up a grassy hill and sits at the top looking smug as he flops down laughing beside her. FPV, the camera flies up the hill behind them. Golden light.
{moss} lies on his back in the grass laughing, a round orange clay cat with a white chest and a long striped tail sitting on his belly. Top-down, the camera spins slowly. Warm golden light.

Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, standing in a sunny rooftop garden with a round orange clay cat with a white chest and a long striped tail perched on his shoulder. The camera pushes in. Warm golden light.
{moss} and a round orange clay cat with a white chest and a long striped tail stretch out side by side in a patch of sun on a rooftop. The camera cranes slowly over them. Warm golden light.
{moss} hands a round orange clay cat with a white chest and a long striped tail a single little clay fish on a blue plate on a picnic blanket on a rooftop. The camera cranes down. Warm sunset light.
Extreme close-up: a round orange clay cat with a white chest and a long striped tail licks her whiskers, eyes half closed with delight. The camera pushes in. Warm sunset light.

{moss} sways in a hammock on a rooftop under warm string lights, a round orange clay cat with a white chest and a long striped tail curled up asleep on his chest. The camera orbits slowly. Warm string-light glow at dusk.
Extreme close-up: a round orange clay cat with a white chest and a long striped tail purring on a mustard-yellow raincoat, her eyes slowly closing. The camera pushes in. Warm lantern glow.

Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, softly, a round orange clay cat with a white chest and a long striped tail asleep in his lap, warm lanterns behind him. The camera slowly pulls back. Warm lantern glow at dusk.

{moss} and a round orange clay cat with a white chest and a long striped tail sit together on a rooftop edge under warm lanterns, watching the first stars come out over the city. The camera slowly drifts up and away. Warm lantern glow against a deep blue dusk.

caption: moss's cat knocked everything off the table until his phone went in the Hibernator. now they go on walks. she's in charge
